quotes.title: Will the “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, for November 20, 2026 be above $0.70?

Prices for other avocado varieties, sizes, package counts, organic avocados, regional tables, “Last Week,” or “Last Year” do not count.
